stem.text: A transverse wave travels along a rope. The graph shows the variation of the displacement of the particles in the rope with distance along it at a particular instant.

stem.alt: Graph of displacement against distance/m (marks at 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0) for a transverse wave; an arrow above the graph is labelled direction of travel of wave.

stem.text: At which distance along the rope do the particles have maximum upwards velocity?
